$comment: Caelora on a 40x30 logical grid. The region wraps the Caeloran Sea, so every settlement sits on the ring of land around it; see src/scenes/regionmap.ts, which fits the coastline to these coordinates. Places whose map does not exist yet still appear, and that is the point: until the player has stood in one it draws as an uncharted mark with no name, so the chart looks bigger than the part that has been walked. Names here are the canon ones from docs/CANON.md. Salthollow keeps the map id tanners_rest, because that id is named in src/scenes/regionmap.ts and in several capture drivers; everything player-facing says Salthollow.

places.name: Briarbell
places.blurb: The bell tree, and the first Kin Hall.

places.name: Stonewake
places.blurb: Quarry city, cut into the mountain. The Stone Hall.

places.name: Eastwind Ridge
places.blurb: Five shelves, hard wind, and the only road there is.

places.name: Salthollow
places.blurb: Tanyard, change paddock, and one long table.

places.name: The Coast Road
places.blurb: Down off the shoulder. The sea long before the sea.

places.name: Route 8
places.blurb: Plains, pine, rock, and then the snow starts.

places.name: The Wintergate
places.blurb: A frozen tarn, a roofless refuge, and four tiles of mountain.

places.name: The Skyreach Stair
places.blurb: A gorge, three bridges, and only two of them standing.

places.name: The Crown Road
places.blurb: Nine hundred years of paving, going downhill at last.

places.name: The Mire Road
places.blurb: Plank over peat, and no ground for a day either way.

places.name: The Central Road
places.blurb: Drained fen, hedged corn, and a main line going the same way you are.

places.name: Marlbeck
places.blurb: One street, and a drain running along above the roofs.

places.name: Harrowgate
places.blurb: A market cross, a grain elevator, and four trains a day.

places.name: Embercoil Pass
places.blurb: Black rock, hot water, and a flow going round in a circle.
